description:
Zoning district of a property in New York City, Chicago or Philadelphia, from the city's own zoning data: the
        district (e.g. R6B, DC-16, RM-1), commercial overlays / overlay districts, special or planned development
        districts, and links to the city's zoning text. `place`: an NYC borough ('Manhattan', 'Brooklyn', 'Queens',
        'Bronx', 'Staten Island'; 'nyc' works when the address names its borough or ZIP), 'chicago' or 'philadelphia'.
        Not an official zoning determination.
name: zoning_lookup
